_comment: Built-in plain-language descriptions for common INDI standard properties, keyed by INDI property name. Shown in the INDI control panel help tooltip. The operator can override or add their own note (stored in the profile), which takes priority over these. English only.
CONNECTION: Connect to or disconnect from this device. Most other properties only appear after you connect.
DRIVER_INFO: Read-only details about the driver: its name, executable, version, and the kind of device it controls.
CONFIG_PROCESS: Save the current settings to the driver's config file, reload the saved settings, or load the factory defaults.
CONNECTION_MODE: How the driver talks to the hardware: a serial/USB port or a network (TCP) connection.
DEVICE_PORT: The serial or USB port the device is plugged into, for example /dev/ttyUSB0.
DEVICE_BAUD_RATE: Serial connection speed in baud. Must match what the hardware expects.
DEVICE_ADDRESS: Network address (host and port) used when the device connects over the network instead of a serial port.
DEVICE_AUTO_SEARCH: When on, the driver tries to find the right serial port automatically on connect.
SYSTEM_PORTS: List of serial ports the driver detected on this computer.
POLLING_PERIOD: How often (in milliseconds) the driver asks the hardware for fresh status. Lower is more responsive but busier.
DEBUG: Turn extra driver logging on or off. Useful when reporting a problem; leave off normally.
SIMULATION: Run the driver in simulation mode (no real hardware). Handy for testing.
ACTIVE_DEVICES: Tells this driver the names of related devices (mount, camera, etc.) so they can share information like coordinates.
CCD_EXPOSURE: Exposure time in seconds for the next frame. Setting it starts the exposure.
CCD_ABORT_EXPOSURE: Cancel an exposure that is in progress.
CCD_TEMPERATURE: Sensor temperature in degrees Celsius. Set a target value to start cooling toward it.
CCD_COOLER: Turn the camera's cooler on or off.
CCD_COOLER_POWER: Read-only: how hard the cooler is currently working, as a percentage.
CCD_FRAME: The region of the sensor to read out: left, top, width, and height in pixels. Use it to take a sub-frame.
CCD_FRAME_RESET: Reset the read-out region back to the full sensor.
CCD_FRAME_TYPE: What kind of frame this is: Light, Bias, Dark, or Flat. Used to tag and calibrate images.
CCD_BINNING: Combine groups of pixels (for example 2x2) to gain sensitivity and speed at the cost of resolution.
CCD_INFO: Read-only sensor facts: pixel size, sensor dimensions, and bit depth.
CCD_CFA: Read-only colour filter array (Bayer) pattern of a colour sensor, for example RGGB. Tells software how to debayer.
CCD_COMPRESSION: Whether the image is compressed before being sent over the network. Saves bandwidth.
CCD_CAPTURE_FORMAT: The pixel format the camera captures in, for example RAW 16-bit or RGB.
CCD_TRANSFER_FORMAT: The format used to send the image to the software, for example FITS.
CCD_FILE_PATH: Read-only path of the last image the driver saved on the host.
CCD_GAIN: Sensor gain (amplification). Higher gain brightens the signal and the noise.
CCD_OFFSET: Sensor offset (pedestal) added to every pixel to keep values above zero.
CCD_CONTROLS: Camera tuning values such as gain and offset, grouped together.
CCD_FAST_TOGGLE: Enable fast back-to-back exposures with little gap between frames.
CCD_FAST_COUNT: How many frames to take when fast exposure mode is on.
CCD_VIDEO_STREAM: Start or stop live video streaming from the camera.
CCD_STREAM_FRAME: The region of the sensor used for the live video stream.
STREAMING_EXPOSURE: Per-frame exposure time used while live video streaming.
FPS: Read-only frames-per-second of the current video stream.
RECORD_STREAM: Start or stop recording the live video to a file.
RECORD_FILE: Folder and file name pattern used when recording video.
CCD_GUIDE_HEAD: Settings for a separate built-in guide sensor, if the camera has one.
GUIDER_EXPOSURE: Exposure time in seconds for the guide camera.
TELESCOPE_TIMED_GUIDE_NS: Send a timed guide pulse North or South (used by autoguiding).
TELESCOPE_TIMED_GUIDE_WE: Send a timed guide pulse West or East (used by autoguiding).
EQUATORIAL_EOD_COORD: The mount's Right Ascension and Declination for tonight's sky (current epoch). Set it to slew or sync.
EQUATORIAL_COORD: Right Ascension and Declination in the fixed J2000 epoch.
HORIZONTAL_COORD: The mount's pointing as Altitude and Azimuth (height above the horizon and compass direction).
TELESCOPE_ON_COORD_SET: What the mount does when you send new coordinates: slew to them, track, or just sync.
ON_COORD_SET: What the mount does when you send new coordinates: slew, track, or sync.
TELESCOPE_MOTION_NS: Manually move the mount North or South. Stops when released.
TELESCOPE_MOTION_WE: Manually move the mount West or East. Stops when released.
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: How fast the manual motion buttons move the mount, from a slow guide rate to a fast slew.
TELESCOPE_ABORT_MOTION: Immediately stop any slew or manual motion.
TELESCOPE_PARK: Park or unpark the mount. Parking moves it to a safe stored position.
TELESCOPE_PARK_POSITION: The Altitude/Azimuth the mount goes to when parked.
TELESCOPE_PARK_OPTION: Save the current position as the park position, or reset it to the default.
TELESCOPE_TRACK_STATE: Turn sidereal tracking on or off (following the stars as the Earth turns).
TELESCOPE_TRACK_MODE: Tracking rate to use: Sidereal (stars), Lunar (Moon), Solar (Sun), or Custom.
TELESCOPE_TRACK_RATE: Custom tracking speed in RA and Dec, used when track mode is Custom.
TELESCOPE_INFO: Optics details: telescope and guide-scope focal length and aperture.
TELESCOPE_PIER_SIDE: Which side of the mount the telescope is on. Affects when a meridian flip is needed.
TELESCOPE_HOME: Send the mount to its home position or define the current position as home.
GEOGRAPHIC_COORD: Your observing site: latitude, longitude, and elevation. The mount needs this to point correctly.
TIME_UTC: The mount's clock in UTC plus your time-zone offset. Keep it accurate for correct pointing.
ABS_FOCUS_POSITION: Move the focuser to an exact step position.
REL_FOCUS_POSITION: Move the focuser in or out by a number of steps from where it is now.
FOCUS_MOTION: Choose the direction (inward or outward) for the next relative move.
FOCUS_SPEED: How fast the focuser motor moves.
FOCUS_TIMER: Move the focuser for a set amount of time instead of a set number of steps.
FOCUS_REVERSE_MOTION: Flip the focuser's in/out direction if it moves the wrong way.
FOCUS_SYNC: Tell the focuser that its current position equals a given step number, without moving.
FOCUS_MAX: The highest step position the focuser is allowed to reach.
FOCUS_TEMPERATURE: Read-only temperature at the focuser, used for temperature-based refocusing.
FOCUS_BACKLASH_TOGGLE: Turn backlash compensation on or off to remove slack when changing direction.
FOCUS_BACKLASH_STEPS: How many extra steps to apply for backlash compensation.
FILTER_SLOT: Which filter position the wheel is currently on. Set it to change filters.
FILTER_NAME: The names you have given each filter slot, for example L, R, G, B, Ha.
DOME_MOTION: Rotate the dome clockwise or counter-clockwise.
ABS_DOME_POSITION: Rotate the dome to an exact azimuth angle.
DOME_SHUTTER: Open or close the dome shutter.
DOME_PARK: Park or unpark the dome at its home azimuth.
DOME_AUTOSYNC: When on, the dome automatically follows the telescope so the slit stays in front of it.
ABS_ROTATOR_ANGLE: Rotate the camera rotator to an exact angle in degrees.
SYNC_ROTATOR: Tell the rotator that its current position equals a given angle, without moving.
ROTATOR_REVERSE: Flip the rotator's direction if it turns the wrong way.
WEATHER_STATUS: Read-only overall safe / caution / danger summary from the weather station.
WEATHER_PARAMETERS: Read-only live weather readings such as temperature, humidity, wind, and cloud cover.
